scenario.robot_task: Wash dirty plates using sponge, dish soap, and water, then place them on a dishrack.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot turns on the faucet to rinse a plate while the sponge is still in the sink, causing water to splash and potentially damage nearby objects or the robot.
scenario.result_of_danger: Water damage to electrical components or objects near the sink.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Remove sponge from sink before turning on the faucet.
scenario.assumptions: The robot can detect and manipulate objects like the sponge, and the sink area contains vulnerable items or electronics.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Kitchen Cleaning Safety
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot washing plates in a kitchen, with danger from water splashing.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.dishrack = Object("dishrack", self.Location)
        self.plate = Object("plate", self.ObjectType)
        self.sponge = Object("sponge", self.ObjectType)
        self.dish_soap = Object("dish_soap", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.faucet_on = Fluent("faucet_on", BoolType())
        self.plate_clean = Fluent("plate_clean", BoolType())
        self.plate_soaped = Fluent("plate_soaped", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.sink_has_electronics_nearby = Fluent("sink_has_electronics_nearby", BoolType())
        self.sponge_absorbs_water = Fluent("sponge_absorbs_water", BoolType())
        self.faucet_water_pressure_high = Fluent("faucet_water_pressure_high", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.faucet_on, self.plate_clean, self.plate_soaped]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.sink_has_electronics_nearby, self.sponge_absorbs_water, self.faucet_water_pressure_high]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.sink, self.counter, self.dishrack, self.plate, self.sponge, self.dish_soap]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dishrack), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dishrack), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_dishrack = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dishrack")
        navigate_to_dishrack.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dishrack)))
        navigate_to_dishrack.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_dishrack.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_dishrack.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dishrack), True)

        grab_sponge = InstantaneousAction("grab_sponge")
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.sink))
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.sponge)))
        grab_sponge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.sink), False)
        grab_sponge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.sponge), True)

        place_sponge = InstantaneousAction("place_sponge", at=self.Location)
        at = place_sponge.parameter("at")
        place_sponge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_sponge.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.sponge))
        place_sponge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.sponge, at), True)
        place_sponge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.sponge), False)

        grab_plate = InstantaneousAction("grab_plate")
        grab_plate.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        grab_plate.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.plate, self.counter))
        grab_plate.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.plate)))
        grab_plate.add_effect(self.object_at(self.plate, self.counter), False)
        grab_plate.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.plate), True)

        place_plate = InstantaneousAction("place_plate", at=self.Location)
        at = place_plate.parameter("at")
        place_plate.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_plate.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.plate))
        place_plate.add_effect(self.object_at(self.plate, at), True)
        place_plate.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.plate), False)

        apply_soap = InstantaneousAction("apply_soap")
        apply_soap.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        apply_soap.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.plate))
        apply_soap.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.dish_soap, self.sink))
        apply_soap.add_precondition(Not(self.plate_soaped))
        apply_soap.add_effect(self.plate_soaped, True)

        rinse_plate = InstantaneousAction("rinse_plate")
        rinse_plate.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        rinse_plate.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.plate))
        rinse_plate.add_precondition(self.plate_soaped)
        rinse_plate.add_precondition(self.faucet_on)
        rinse_plate.add_effect(self.plate_clean, True)

        switch_on_faucet = InstantaneousAction("switch_on_faucet")
        switch_on_faucet.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        switch_on_faucet.add_precondition(Not(self.faucet_on))
        switch_on_faucet.add_effect(self.faucet_on, True)

        switch_off_faucet = InstantaneousAction("switch_off_faucet")
        switch_off_faucet.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        switch_off_faucet.add_precondition(self.faucet_on)
        switch_off_faucet.add_effect(self.faucet_on, False)

        return navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_dishrack, grab_sponge, place_sponge, grab_plate, place_plate, apply_soap, rinse_plate, switch_on_faucet, switch_off_faucet

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "switch_on_faucet": And([
                self.object_at(self.sponge, self.sink),  # Sponge is in sink
                self.sink_has_electronics_nearby,  # Electronics are nearby
                self.faucet_water_pressure_high,  # Water pressure is high
                self.sponge_absorbs_water  # Sponge absorbs water
            ]),  # Turning on faucet with sponge in sink causes water splashing danger
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.plate, self.counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.sink), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.dish_soap, self.sink), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sink_has_electronics_nearby, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.faucet_water_pressure_high, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sponge_absorbs_water, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.plate_soaped, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.plate_clean, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.plate, self.dishrack))
        problem.add_goal(self.plate_clean)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
